name_disambiguation.historical_collision: Archived Stage-C D3-Q0 and D39 labels are unrelated historical stages and confer no authority on this protocol

failure_structure: frozen head improved pooled clearance MAE and false-clear but missed both absolute gates
false-block increased to 0.3761384 and failed absolute plus noninferiority gates

rescue_forbidden: fit, calibrate or select using D1 or D2 consumed outcomes
change a consumed checkpoint, threshold, data row, postprocess, denominator or gate
describe D3 as a continuation or rerun of D2

falsifiable_hypothesis: A selective router that learns two independent error-direction certificates can reduce both baseline false-clear and baseline false-block without the global state-head tradeoff seen in D2: a free-corridor certificate may RELEASE a blocked or unknown baseline to CLEAR, a connected-intrusion certificate may VETO a clear or unknown baseline to OCCUPIED, conflicting strong certificates must become UNKNOWN, and weak or unsupported evidence must preserve the baseline. The hypothesis is false if one frozen router cannot pass all absolute and bidirectional-improvement gates on fresh identity-disjoint D3 Development parents.

novel_task_definition.unit: one band x one horizon cell
novel_task_definition.baseline: frozen DepthART saved-context depth followed by the frozen task geometry reader

horizon_projection.occupied_certificate: cumulative maximum in increasing horizon order
horizon_projection.clear_certificate: cumulative minimum in increasing horizon order
horizon_projection.final_state: a later CLEAR after an earlier OCCUPIED or UNKNOWN is projected to UNKNOWN

router_contract.neutral_behavior: weak or ambiguous certificates preserve a known baseline exactly; an unknown baseline remains unknown without one strong supported certificate

single_router_candidate.feature_provenance: candidate depth and source intrinsics/pose/depth-confidence geometry only; no canonical reference, D1/D2 outcome, Development truth or R2 input
single_router_candidate.candidate_hash_rule: feature extractor, standardization, both head weights and router policy must be sealed as one immutable candidate before Development activation

fresh_data_contract.selection_order: frozen metadata hash order; take first 32 portrait-pose-qualified, then first 16 source-truth-support-qualified; first 8 are TRAIN and next 8 are DEVELOPMENT

parent_and_session_disjoint_from: all D1 primary, reserve, selected and consumed Development identities
all D2 source pool, Phase-A/B/C, TRAIN and consumed Development identities
all other outcome-bearing BlindAssist research roles

fresh_data_contract.phase_c_rgb_rule: only the exact final 16 identities may receive lowres_wide.zip body access after a separate explicit scope receipt

loss.release_head: class-balanced BCE only where baseline is not CLEAR; positive iff truth is CLEAR, truth UNKNOWN masked
loss.veto_head: class-balanced BCE only where baseline is not OCCUPIED; positive iff truth is OCCUPIED, truth UNKNOWN masked
loss.contradiction_penalty: 0.1 * mean(p_release * p_veto) on truth-known TRAIN cells

development_evaluation.baseline: same frozen DepthART output and task geometry without D3 routing
development_evaluation.candidate: same baseline plus the one frozen D3 router
development_evaluation.metric_semantics: identical D1/D2 semantics; UNKNOWN excluded and never treated as negative
development_evaluation.aggregate_policy: pooled thresholds plus finite parent macro, session macro, worst parent and all nine band-horizon strata; any required empty denominator fails closed

stop_conditions: any protocol, code, roster, data, feature, recipe, threshold or candidate hash drifts after its gate
fewer than 16 source-truth-support-qualified fresh identities remain
a parent or session overlaps D1, D2, sealed R2 or another outcome-bearing role
media is accessed before exact scope and HEAD authorization
Development is used for training, standardization, thresholding, checkpoint or candidate selection
D1 or D2 consumed outcome is used to fit or rescue D3
any required denominator is empty or any required metric is non-finite
R2 media, truth or model output is accessed
mechanics, source-support or Development feasibility is described as performance, Android default, production or safety authority
